notes.title: Console release
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the game was released on Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, PS4 and PS Vita on August 19.
This is a very enjoyable event for us, and we hope that it will be the first step towards gaining recognition from new players.
Stay tuned for more news about our new projects.

notes.title: Console release
notes.notes:
Today we're excited to announce that Norman's Great Illusion is coming to Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, PS4 and PS Vita on August 19th. The Xbox One and Nintendo Switch versions are now available for pre-order! At the same time, all two weeks before the release there will be a 20% discount on pre-order!

This is our first game outside of Steam and we hope it won't be the last.
Stay tuned for more news on our new projects.

notes.title: Unexpected update
notes.notes:
By the numerous requests of the players, we introduced into the game an easy difficulty in which more time is given to solve the equations.
In addition, we fixed several small bugs.
And the main character got a cute cat.
